caseNameFull: Moore v. Shapiro, Governor of Illinois
attorneys: Richard F. Watt on the motion., William G. Clark, Attorney General of Illinois, and John J. O’Toole and Thomas E. Brannigan, Assistant Attorneys General, for appellees in opposition.

opinions.text: Appeal from D. C. N. D. Ill. Because of the representation of the State of Illinois that “it would be a physical impossibility” for the State “to effectuate the relief which the appellants seek,” the “Motion to Advance and Expedite the Hearing and Disposition of this Cause” is denied.
